definition: Representing a scene as a neural field queried by position and view direction, reconstructing photorealistic novel views from a set of photos.
details: Representing a scene as a neural field queried by position and view direction, reconstructing photorealistic novel views from a set of photos. The breakthrough that made learned 3D scene representation mainstream.

explainer.lead: NeRF represents a scene as a neural field queried by position and view direction, reconstructing photorealistic novel views from a set of photos. It was the breakthrough that made learned 3D scene representation mainstream.

tiers.eli5: You give it a stack of photos of a place, and it learns the place well enough to draw convincing pictures from angles nobody photographed.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers fit a neural field to posed photos and render new views by querying it along camera rays. A pitfall is that novel views depend entirely on the input photos and are only as reliable as their coverage.
tiers.paperLevel: A scene is represented as a neural field queried by position and view direction, trained from photos to reconstruct novel views. Cited as the breakthrough that made learned 3D scene representation mainstream.

explainer.example: From a set of photos of a room, the trained field renders a photorealistic view from a position no camera occupied.
